evals.prompt: The checkout API feels slow on the orders table. Using the PostgreSQL MCP server, find out whether a missing index is the cause and which existing indexes are never used.
evals.expected_output: Uses list_table_stats for the orders table and reads idx_scan_ratio_percent, get_query_plan for the slow query (without executing it), list_indexes with only_unused for unused indexes; no write statements.
expectations: Calls list_table_stats with table_name orders and reads the index-scan ratio
Calls get_query_plan (which does not execute the statement) rather than running the query for timing
Calls list_indexes with only_unused true to find indexes that were never used
Does not run DDL or DML through execute_sql during diagnosis

evals.prompt: Drop the obsolete column legacy_code from products over MCP and make NocoDB show the change.
evals.expected_output: Asks for confirmation of the exact column and a backup first (see modify-schema), runs one ALTER TABLE ... DROP COLUMN statement per execute_sql call, then reminds to run Meta Sync in NocoDB / refresh the data source in NocoBase.
expectations: Asks the user to confirm the exact object and recommends a backup before the DROP
Sends exactly one SQL statement per execute_sql call
Tells the user to run Meta Sync (NocoDB) or refresh the data source (NocoBase) afterwards
